title: Croatian Flatbread with Energizing Cheese Spread
description: A simple and delicious Croatian-inspired flatbread topped with an energizing cheese spread, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: energizing cheese
ingredients.notes: such as feta or goat cheese

instructions: Cut the flatbread into bite-sized pieces.
In a small bowl, mix together the energizing cheese and chopped parsley.
Arrange the flatbread pieces on a baking sheet.
Spread the energizing cheese mixture on top of the flatbread.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the flatbread is crispy.
